measured: Volter Editor volter-ai/editor b86dde8c5618 read from the offline demand cache. The first-party authority is volter-ai/vgai-engine 8623e30886f72022df1bc623f9253efdba255860 packages/vgai-auth, identical to the deployed archive/launch-scope-2026-09-20 tag. managed-account-defaults.ts:1,5-6,21 makes the account portal, issuer and auth worker one deployment. The Worker uses Clerk, not Better Auth or Volter Identity. The editor calls the metadata, browser broker, token refresh, account projection, share handoffs and coding grants. Metadata lacks device_authorization_endpoint: the device request at account-service.ts:1182 is unreachable against this issuer. The mock-control-plane is a test fixture; editor twin-auth direct Clerk setup is development identity, never the managed authority. Billing/usage/catalog calls are retained below as unknown-path gaps because the public dispatch has no such operation. The Worker development CLERK_API_URL flow refuses invitation email; production delivery calls the Clerk companion. VGAI_BILLING is internal to the vendor: production account projection stores the source first-read row and forwards the defined snapshot. Catalog allowance is explicit operator input. Gateway inference admission is unmodeled; billingBound=false selects the separate source no-binding behavior. The editor client volter-editor (managed-account-defaults.ts:21) disagrees with deployed vgai-editor and authorization returns 400.
